scope: Comparison against the vendor's own boot log and shared-memory table, plus one negative experiment on the HS1 response format. Read-only device access; no firmware payload dumped.

correction_to_earlier_evidence.claim: the vendor trace continues with UM12_005 after MF04_003, so our MD diverges there
correction_to_earlier_evidence.problem: that capture attached ~10.4 s after boot and contains no boot-phase operations at all: zero occurrences of md_nv_config, INFO_FILE, NV0S_000, Restore or FAT6F*. It is the post-READY steady-state NVRAM pass (2180 CMPT_Read over ~21 s), not the boot scan
correction_to_earlier_evidence.consequence: our boot-phase sequence has no vendor counterpart in that file; the earlier comparison was invalid and is withdrawn

vendor_boot_timeline.implication: the vendor reaches HS2 about 1.7 s after start, before the long NVRAM scan; our MD performs the full 859-request scan before HS2, which is the same-board first-boot rebuild path

ap_runtime_data_check.vendor_struct: struct ap_query_md_feature_v2_1 (156 B) plus a 16 B CCCI header
ap_runtime_data_check.result: every field matches, including the MPU ranges (0x40000000+0x1800000 and 0x48000000+0x4960000) that the vendor logs

smem_table_check.vendor_source: init_smem_regions lines in the boot log
smem_table_check.result: identical for every region, including RAW_MDSS_DBG 0x8e110800/0x40110800/0x3800, RAW_RUNTIME_DATA 0x8e11e800/0x4011e800/0x1000, CCISM_SCP 0x8e120000/0x40120000/0x8000, CCISM_MCU, CCISM_MCU_EXP, MD_NVRAM_CACHE 0x88180000/0x48180000/0x700000, RAW_MD_CONSYS 0x88000000/0x48000000/0x180000, CCB control and the CCB aggregate
smem_table_check.conclusion: the AP-published shared-memory geometry is not the cause

negative_experiment_hs1_records.change: emit a record only for features that negotiated to MUST_SUPPORT, matching the vendor's append_runtime_feature() behaviour
negative_experiment_hs1_records.interpretation: the MD stops completely when the response omits records for features it queried as optional; it expects an answer record per queried feature, so the sparse vendor layout is not equivalent for this firmware and the change was reverted

new_diagnostic.content: one line per present LK user: id, AP view, MD view, size and the cached/preserve/nomap flags
new_diagnostic.limits: numbers only, read-only, no payload reachable

not_claimed: that the vendor boot sequence is fully understood
that the MD fault is explained
